answer: Here is one mechanism that works: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because timber only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, fable is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any spiral approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
